notes: Presco Plc — Nigerian Stock Exchange listed integrated palm oil producer. Owns ~40,000 ha (~99k acres) of oil palm plantations + extraction mills + refinery in Edo / Delta States. Acquired Saro Oil Palm Company (~14k ha) and Ghana Oil Palm Development Co. (GOPDC) stake during FY2023-2024. Calendar fiscal year. NGN reporting; figures in NGN millions. FY2023-2024 results reflect significant boost from Naira devaluation (NGN-denominated CPO realised prices tracked global USD prices). Ramp in revenue/EBITDA from FY2022 onwards reflects both Naira devaluation (NGN/USD ~415 in 2022 → ~1,500 in 2024) and palm-oil price strength. Land book reflects revaluation gains. Acres ~99k (40k ha). Net debt swung positive from FY2023 due to Saro / GOPDC acquisitions financed by debt. Pre-FY2022 financials reflect a much smaller business (only Presco core ~20k ha) and pre-devaluation exchange rates.

periods.notes: FY20: COVID year, palm-oil prices recovered H2
FY21: CPO price rally, record net income
FY22: Saro Oil Palm acquisition closed; CPO prices peaked, leverage rose
FY23: GOPDC stake + Saro full year; Naira devalued sharply (June 2023), revenue +59% YoY
FY24: full-year Naira devaluation (NGN ~1,500/USD avg); CPO realised prices tracked USD strength; record EBITDA
